description: The file defines a PHP class `ListViewXTPL` which extends `ListViewDisplay`. It manages rendering of list views with support for pagination, sorting arrows, and templating via XTemplate. It is used within the SuiteCRM/SugarCRM framework for displaying list views with additional templating features.

classes.name: ListViewXTPL
classes.description: A class extending ListViewDisplay that renders list views using XTemplate, with support for pagination, sorting arrows, and additional templating features within the SuiteCRM framework.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes data to generate the list view HTML using XTemplate, including assigning data, handling pagination, and rendering rows.

methods.name: processArrows
methods.description: Sets up sorting arrows in the template based on current sorting order.

methods.name: processPagination
methods.description: Generates and assigns pagination links at the top and bottom of the view.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Displays the generated list view, either echoing it or returning as a string.
